strapiBlog.title: PropTech Connect 2026: Dubai to Host the World’s Largest Real Estate Tech Event
strapiBlog.short_description: Dubai is all set to host the highly awaited global conference, the PropTech Connect 2026.

data.text:
Dubai is all set to host the highly awaited global conference, the PropTech Connect 2026. Organized by the Dubai Land Department, this mega event will bring together industry leaders, investors, and technology pioneers to explore cutting-edge innovations—such as blockchain, artificial intelligence, and data analytics—that are transforming the future of real estate. Let’s find out more about Dubai PropTech Connect 2026.

About Dubai PropTech Connect 2026

DLD has announced that the emirate will host PropTech Connect 2026, the world’s largest global conference and exhibition dedicated to real estate technology. 

Director General of the Dubai Land Department, H.E, Marwan Ahmed bin Khalifa, said, 

“Through this global conference and exhibition, we aim to attract leading companies specializing in real estate technology and provide an opportunity for investors and decision-makers to explore the latest technological innovations that contribute to the development and future outlook of real estate”.

The conference will showcase expert-led panel discussions on emerging PropTech trends, live demonstrations of next-generation real estate solutions, and workshops on AI-driven property investments. Attendees will also benefit from exclusive networking opportunities with top-tier investors and key decision-makers.

Key objectives of Dubai PropTech Connect 2026 include:

  • Attracting leading PropTech companies to Dubai.
  • Enhancing market transparency and investor confidence.
  • Accelerating the digital transformation of the real estate sector.
  • Driving collaboration between industry leaders to implement tech-driven solutions.

PropTech Connect 2026: Advancing Dubai’s Strategic Vision

Dubai’s emergence as a global PropTech hub reflects its broader vision for technological excellence and digital advancement. Under the leadership of His Highness Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, the emirate has positioned itself at the forefront of smart real estate solutions.

As the world’s largest PropTech event, this conference presents an unparalleled opportunity for investors, tech entrepreneurs, and real estate professionals to collaborate, innovate, and shape the future of Dubai real estate. Whether you are an industry leader or a technology pioneer, this is an event you cannot afford to miss.
